_note: Written before any compile. Unseen paraphrases of B_four_right ('a four-legged robot that walks sideways to the right'). A compiled spec passes if (1) its body constraints admit 4 legs and exclude 2 and 6, and (2) among the motion primitives below, 'right' gets the strictly highest objective. 'right_turning' is diagnostic only (does the spec prefer straight over curving?).
